modern: Let it not be in any man’s power to say truly of you that you are not simple or that you are not good; but let anyone who thinks anything of this kind about you be a liar; and this is entirely in your power. For who is there that can stop you from being good and simple? Only decide to live no longer unless you are such. For neither does reason allow you to live, if you are not such.
original: Let it not be in any man’s power to say truly of thee that thou are not simple or that thou art not good; but let him be a liar whoever shall think anything of this kind about thee; and this is altogether in thy power. For who is he that shall hinder thee from being good and simple? Do thou only determine to live no longer unless thou shalt be such. For neither does reason allow [thee to live], if thou art not such.
